svg.text: Stage order is immutable. Each group emits its own progress events and hands the next one a typed record.
corrupt media · bad zip member · unmatched image
recorded in the manifest — the job continues
missing config · missing or corrupt model · dead storage
monotonic per job, streamed live over SSE
TYPED HAND-OFFS — no shared mutable context, no stage reaches back
